يجتنبون (form VIII)
# يَجْتَنِبُونَ (yajtanibūna) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ni.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# يُجْتَنَبُونَ (yujtanabūna) /jud͡ʒ.ta.na.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
